loop: CANDIDATE -> DIAGNOSE WEAKNESS -> IDENTIFY LIMITING FEATURE -> GENERATE CONTROLLED MUTATION -> RE-EVALUATE EVIDENCE/MECHANISM/PRIOR ART -> RE-SCORE -> KEEP OR KILL -> REPEAT

SPAN_DERIVATION_MIN.justification: the engine's own span-derivation rule (candidate_diversity.span_derivation_check): ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED. A MECHANISM_STRENGTHENING mutation must CLEAR this floor — the same rule that gates the grid, not a new one.

EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_MIN.justification: I1's underived flag fires below 0.20; an EVIDENCE_DERIVED_CONSTRAINT mutation must clear the same floor on evidence_support.

DOMAIN_OVERLAP_MIN.justification: REPLAY_CACHE re-adjudication is valid only while the mutated candidate stays in the domain the cached art was found FOR. Guard: >= 1 NON-generic technical term shared between the child's mechanism+intervention and the cached family corpus. ZERO overlap means the mutation abandoned the domain (measured attack: re-adjudicating a cement-curing intervention against battery art fabricates surviving differentiators — false novelty from stale art). The overlap count is RECORDED on every cache adjudication so thin-domain links are auditable. NOTE: entity-term retention vs the problem CANNOT catch this class — entity terms are problem-derived and unchanged by mutations (measured while writing the guard's tests); it is recorded for audit only.

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO minimum loop is DIAGNOSE -> IMPROVE -> RE-EVALUATE -> IMPROVE AGAIN; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

fields.MECHANISM: Intrinsic thermal instability and thermal heterogeneity accelerate capacity fade and drive localized degradation, elevating the risk of thermal runaway by manifesting in-plane and through-thickness temperature gradients that influence electrochemical behavior.
fields.INTERVENTION: Integrate intelligent, multiscale thermal sensing that utilizes surface-mounted and embedded sensors along with indirect diagnostic methods and data-driven prediction techniques to enable proactive thermal management, thereby enhancing the safety, reliability, and efficiency of next-generation LIBs.
fields.EXPECTED_EFFECT: The battery warning light will no longer trigger falsely during cold-idle conditions because proactive thermal management accounts for thermal effects on performance and lifetime, preventing transient electrochemical deviations from being misinterpreted as faults.
fields.FALSIFICATION_TEST: If implementing multiscale thermal sensing and proactive thermal management fails to eliminate the intermittent battery warning light flash at cold idle below 0C, the hypothesis that thermal heterogeneity and localized degradation drive the fault is falsified.
fields.MECHANISM_SOURCE_SPAN: Thermal heterogeneity accelerates capacity fade, drives localized degradation, and elevates the risk of thermal runaway (TR), particularly in high-energy-density and fast-charging systems.
fields.EXPERIMENT: Deploy a prototype BMS equipped with embedded sensors and data-driven prediction techniques for proactive thermal management on a 2015 Toyota Camry and compare the incidence of intermittent battery warning light flashes at cold idle (below 0C) against the stock BMS operating without multiscale thermal sensing.
fields.EXPERIMENT_BASELINE: stock BMS operating without multiscale thermal sensing
fields.CONSTRAINT_DERIVED: The diagnostic system must monitor in-plane and through-thickness temperature gradients to mitigate thermal heterogeneity-induced capacity fade and localized degradation.
fields.MUTATION_REASON: Repairs I1_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_DERIVATION by replacing the unsupported impedance mechanism with a mechanism and intervention that directly reuse the verbatim evidence span's vocabulary regarding thermal heterogeneity and proactive thermal management.

fields.MECHANISM: Temperature-dependent electrochemical impedance and internal resistance variability in lithium-ion batteries causes transient voltage drops at cold idle, where thermal heterogeneity accelerates capacity fade and drives localized degradation, leading to the battery warning light flashing.
fields.INTERVENTION: Implement a cold-weather diagnostic threshold in the battery management system that compensates voltage readings for low-temperature internal resistance changes, utilizing the system-level diagnostics and control frameworks that link quantitative, stage-specific failure indicators to system-level interventions for intrinsic safety design.
fields.EXPECTED_EFFECT: The battery warning light will no longer trigger falsely during cold-idle conditions due to transient voltage drops misinterpreted as charging faults, as the BMS accounts for the temperature-dependent internal resistance changes.
fields.FALSIFICATION_TEST: Measure the internal resistance and voltage drop at 0°C and -20°C; if the voltage drop at -20°C is not significantly higher than at 0°C, or if the warning light does not trigger at -20°C idle but does at 0°C, the mechanism is falsified.
fields.MECHANISM_SOURCE_SPAN: Temperature-dependent electrochemical impedance and internal resistance variability in lithium-ion batteries causes transient voltage drops at cold idle, where thermal heterogeneity accelerates capacity fade and drives localized degradation
fields.EXPERIMENT: Compare the battery warning light trigger frequency and internal resistance measurements between the candidate BMS with cold-weather compensation and the standard BMS without compensation during cold-idle conditions below 0C.
fields.CONSTRAINT_DERIVED: The BMS must account for thermal heterogeneity and localized degradation in its voltage compensation algorithm to prevent false triggers at cold idle.

CROSS_DOMAIN_MIN_NONGENERIC_OVERLAP.justification: R377 patent-text ground truth (TOSCANINI/R377_PATENT_TEXT_FETCH.json + R377_PATENT_TEXT_GROUND_TRUTH.json): 12/30 family representatives (40%) were substantively irrelevant cross-domain term collisions (CWDM optical link for a battery-thermal candidate; dental-condition monitoring for rolling stock; bone fracture forceps for rail steel...). A hit sharing NO entity term with the candidate now needs >= 3 NON-generic mechanism terms to be mechanism art: the measured true cross-domain analog (line-pipe steel with hydrogen fracture toughness for a rail-steel candidate) shares 3 non-generic terms and survives; every measured false positive shares <= 2 and is demoted. This RAISES the cross-domain bar (was the same >= 2 as same-domain) — stricter, not weaker (Art. VII).
CROSS_DOMAIN_MIN_NONGENERIC_OVERLAP.uncertainty: term overlap remains a proxy; entity word-sense collisions ('gear': steering vs draft) can still pass — disclosed limitation, not a solved problem

MIN_MECHANISM_OVERLAP.justification: same term-overlap rule family as the pipeline relevance adjudicator and the Q2 instrument (>= 2 shared content terms = domain-specific rather than accidental collision); NOT weakened relative to any prior gate
MIN_MECHANISM_OVERLAP.uncertainty: term overlap is a proxy for mechanism identity

ANTICIPATION_COVERAGE_RATIO.justification: a family ANTICIPATES only when nearly ALL elements of the candidate's FULL distinguishing set (uncapped — the claim elements, not the 6-term query core) appear in the family's claim/abstract text; 0.8 leaves a >= 20% element margin — anything lower would convert partial art into a kill (Art. XXVIII forbids). Measured adversarial case: a domain-only patent reached 0.857 against a capped denominator whose true differentiators (acoustic, multi-modal) had been ranked out
ANTICIPATION_COVERAGE_RATIO.uncertainty: claim coverage measured by term overlap, not a claim chart; recorded per family with evidence tier
